reason: Provides OpenCode-compatible web search for DeepSeek Harness by routing the host web-search capability to Exa or Parallel MCP endpoints and returning formatted results with sources.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供兼容 OpenCode 的网页搜索能力，通过 Exa 或 Parallel MCP 服务查询并返回带来源的结果。
summaries.en: Adds OpenCode-compatible web search to DeepSeek Harness by querying Exa or Parallel MCP services and returning results with source metadata.

capabilities: Performs web searches through Exa or Parallel MCP endpoints
Makes outbound network requests to configured third-party search services
Supports optional Exa and Parallel API credentials
Returns search content and source metadata to the host web-search tool
